title: Strux
description: A real-time collaborative document editor supporting 10+ concurrent users via Yjs CRDTs and WebSockets, with Git-style branching over TipTap and PostgreSQL.

title: Converge
description: A React Native mobile data aggregator that captures links, posts, and screenshots into a unified feed, with Node.js LLM parsing and Pinecone semantic search.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This personal portfolio site from DSC 106 Labs 1–4, built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript modules for navigation, themes, and dynamic project data.

title: Nutritional Equity Index
description: HDSI research modeling a ZIP-level Nutritional Equity Index from food distribution records, using pandas on a panel of 100,000 administrative records.

title: Power Outage Duration Analytics
description: A data pipeline processing 1,535 federal electrical grid records to model major outage durations with pandas, permutation tests, and Random Forest regression.

title: ACM Club Websites
description: Next.js and Tailwind CSS club websites built with ACM to scale user acquisition across 300+ active student members, with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
